question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a permanent public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-payload` contract, or remain internal/plugin-local?
rationale: The PR adds an externally consumable constant and predicate; repository policy treats plugin API direction and compatibility as a maintainer-owned choice.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the generic constant and predicate as the canonical cross-plugin progress intent and lock their intended use with focused contract coverage.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Move the helpers behind an internal or plugin-local seam to avoid creating a new third-party API commitment.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic constant and predicate as the canonical cross-plugin progress intent and lock their intended use with focused contract coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest connection to Slack delivery, plugin SDK surface design, and Codex projector architecture.
